create_CAPE1d_embeddings: create a CAPE1d module with a given d_model dimension for continuous positional embeddings
run_CAPE1d_forward: run the CAPE1d forward pass to add positional embeddings to input tensor x
compute_CAPE1d_pos_emb: compute positional embeddings from input tensor x with optional x_lengths and positions_delta
augment_CAPE1d_positions: augment positions with random global shift, local shift, and scaling during training
review_CAPE1d_class: review the CAPE1d class for continuous positional encoding with augmentation support
